prompt_md: How many three-digit numbers have digits that strictly increase from left to right, like 147 or 389?
prompt_short: Three-digit numbers with strictly increasing digits?
hint_md: Once you pick three different digits, there's only one increasing order.
explain_intuition_md: Choosing any 3 of the 10 digits gives 120 sets, each with exactly one increasing order. But any set containing 0 would have to start with 0, which isn't a three-digit number. So only the digits 1 to 9 are allowed.
